name: inflate-repo
description: Repo-root orchestration scripts only (AD-012) — the real projects are extension/, host/, and corpus/.

scripts.corpus: npm --prefix corpus install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix corpus run corpus
scripts.package: cd host && ./gradlew shadowJar --console=plain && cp build/libs/inflate-host.jar ../extension/host.jar && cd ../extension && npm run package
